statement: Let Y be a smooth complex projective variety. Let V 1, . . . , V k be proper irreducible components of RatCurvesn (Y ) whose numerical classes are linearly independent. For every y ∈ Y , the ordered endpoint locus is either empty or satisfies dim Locus(V 1 , . . . , V k )y ≥ k X j=1 (−KY · V j − 1).
